title: The Journey editor's cover band gets the Space header control back: the cover previews at the hero's crop shape with the drag-to-focus marker on it

source.ref: Owner request 2026-09-30: "check the header image focus picker. It used to be there but it got removed. I liked the one we developed for Spaces, please reinstate that." ADR-1699

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-09-30 (ADR-1699). PREMISE RE-TESTED (ADR-1082) at 38a5b1a15 before building. The Spaces control the owner liked is components/ui/header-image-field.tsx (HeaderImageField: the cover previewed at the hero's crop shape, ImageFocalPicker's drag-to-focus marker on it, Replace and Remove over it), extracted from the Space branding form in #1826 and still mounted on the Space (space-branding-form.tsx, reached from the Space rail's space.basics and the Manage hub's Profile and Settings tab), the profile form, the storefront banner and the Journey rail. The event, Circle and Channel rails still carry ImageFocalPicker. No mount was deleted: git log -G on the picker's JSX since June shows only replacements. THE GAP is the Journey single-page editor at /journeys/<slug>/edit. Its cover band was a bare ImageUpload with no focus, and the settings column that holds the Journey's HeaderImageField is mounted there with hideIdentity, which hides it (and the page never passed initialCoverFocus). So an author, or a Space manager editing a Space's Journey since LIVE-732, could set a cover in the editor but not frame it, although journey_plans.cover_focus is stored and the Journey page crops its PageHero cover by it (entityFocus: plan.cover_focus). WHAT CHANGED. The editor's cover band is HeaderImageField, seeded from plan.cover_focus and writing it through setJourneyHeaderFocus (the rail's action, same canEditJourney gate), debounced 400 ms, at the rail's 16:6 preview. HeaderImageField gains an optional uploadFn passed to its empty dropzone, so the editor keeps its server-side cover upload for a dropped file. No new picker, no new column, no migration. components/journey/v2/journey-builder-cover-focus.test.tsx renders the editor (the preview crops by the saved object-position, the marker and Replace / Remove are present) and folds the stored value through asIdentityHero into PageHero's object-position; it fails on main.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const fail=(m)=>{console.error("LIVE-738: "+m);process.exit(1)};const read=(f)=>{if(!fs.existsSync(f))fail(f+" is gone");return fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8")};const B=read("components/journey/v2/journey-builder.tsx");const band=B.match(/<HeaderImageField\b[\s\S]*?\/>/);if(!band)fail("the Journey editor cover band does not mount HeaderImageField, the Space header control");if(!/label="Cover"/.test(band[0])||!/focus=\{focus\}/.test(band[0])||!/onFocusChange=\{onFocusChange\}/.test(band[0]))fail("the editor cover band mounts HeaderImageField without its saved focus and focus setter");if(/<ImageUpload\s+label="Cover"/.test(B))fail("the bare cover upload box is still in the editor");if(!/setJourneyHeaderFocus\(planId,/.test(B))fail("a focus drag in the editor never writes journey_plans.cover_focus");if(!/readJourneyCoverFocus\(initialCoverFocus\)/.test(B))fail("the editor does not seed the marker from the saved focus");const E=read("app/(main)/journeys/[slug]/edit/page.tsx");if(!/initialCoverFocus=\{plan\.cover_focus\}/.test(E))fail("the edit page does not hand the editor the stored cover_focus");const P=read("app/(main)/journeys/[slug]/page.tsx");if(!/entityFocus:\s*plan\.cover_focus/.test(P))fail("the Journey page no longer crops its cover by cover_focus");const H=read("components/ui/header-image-field.tsx");if(!/<ImageFocalPicker[\s\S]*?value=\{focus\}[\s\S]*?onChange=\{onFocusChange\}/.test(H))fail("HeaderImageField no longer carries the drag-to-focus picker");if(!/objectPosition:\s*coverFocus/.test(read("components/templates/page-hero.tsx")))fail("PageHero no longer applies coverFocus as the cover object-position");console.log("ok: the Journey editor cover band is HeaderImageField seeded from and writing journey_plans.cover_focus, and the Journey page crops its PageHero cover by that column")'
verify.note: Closed 2026-09-30 (ADR-1699). Reads the wiring from both ends: the editor's cover band is HeaderImageField with the saved focus and its setter, the bare Cover upload is gone, a drag writes through setJourneyHeaderFocus, the marker seeds from initialCoverFocus, the edit page passes plan.cover_focus, the Journey page crops by entityFocus: plan.cover_focus, HeaderImageField still carries ImageFocalPicker, and PageHero still applies coverFocus as object-position. Fails on main (38a5b1a15) at the first arm. Exits 1 naming the file when a wired file is gone.
